verdict.rationale: Mastra documents its own pre-production testing: Studio is an interface for testing agents, workflows and tools, apps can run locally before being deployed to Mastra Cloud, and agent runs can be scored before changes reach production. Nothing in the evidence describes an isolated sandbox environment or any separation of test data from production data, so this reads as local dev and evals rather than true sandbox isolation. Missing for 10: a documented sandbox or isolated test environment, guarantees of separate test versus production data stores, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Studio is the interface for building, testing, and managing agents, workflows, and tools.
Register agents and workflows on one Mastra server, run it locally, and deploy the same app to Mastra Cloud.
Score agent runs against repeatable checks before changes reach production.
